pick.headline: First Palestinian intifada begins in Gaza
pick.summary: On 9 December 1987, after an Israeli truck collided with cars carrying Palestinian workers in Gaza, protests spread into a general uprising in the occupied territories.
pick.significance: The intifada brought the Palestinian question back to the centre of world politics and led the US to open a dialogue with the PLO a year later.

alternates.headline: Lech Walesa elected president of Poland
alternates.summary: On 9 December 1990 Lech Walesa, the Solidarity leader, won Poland's presidential run-off election against Stanislaw Tyminski.
alternates.significance: The electrician who led the 1980 strikes became head of state ten years later.
